blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines will host two new Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) centers focused on creative industries and maritime cooperation. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto announced the development on Sunday, describing the two centers as concrete outcomes of the Philippines’ hosting of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 17. “The one for creative industries will incubate great startups. The maritime cooperation center, on the other hand, will help advance negotiations on the South China Sea Code of Conduct,” said Recto, who also chairs the Asean National Organizing Council.
